_comment: Vermona DRM1 MKIII factory MIDI map (manual p.19, MIDI channel 10). Closed hats sit exactly 2 semitones below open — the hardware rule. Roles: drum1/drum2 are the two analog DRUM channels (tom/conga duty), multi is the MULTI channel (rim/cowbell/zap duty), hh1* is the HI HAT 1 channel used as cymbal/ride voice.
